slides.lead: Most users decide in the first minute. Here's how not to lose them.

slides.h2: Only ask for what you need now.
slides.lead: Every extra field is a reason to close the app. Collect the rest later.

slides.h2: Let them see why it's worth it.
slides.lead: Before the sign-up wall, show what's waiting on the other side.
Get them to the one action that matters. They'll find the rest.
Notifications on launch? No. Right after they do something worth being notified about? Yes.
Don't help. Don't explain. Every pause is a fix on your list.
